lines.speaker: Flora
lines.text: We need fruit for the stores as well as vegetables. Bring me some apples.

lines.speaker: Flora
lines.text: Good. Keep an eye out for apple saplings when you’re gathering. Those are worth bringing home.

lines.speaker: Tillman
lines.text: Put them aside for now. We’ll need them when the orchard’s ready.
lines.orchardText: Save them for the orchard. You can choose what to plant there.

lines.speaker: Tillman
lines.text: Bring me some pears this time. I’ll put them with the apples.

lines.speaker: Tillman
lines.text: That’ll keep us going. Pear saplings are worth bringing back too.

lines.speaker: Flora
lines.text: Leave the fruit in the stores before you start planning more trees.

lines.speaker: Flora
lines.text: Tillman’s had his pears. Bring me some peaches—this one’s my choice.

lines.speaker: Flora
lines.text: These are for eating fresh.

lines.speaker: Tillman
lines.text: I wasn’t going to argue.

lines.speaker: Flora
lines.text: And save any peach saplings you find for planting.

lines.speaker: Tillman
lines.text: Flora got her peaches. I’m asking for cherries.

lines.speaker: Flora
lines.text: Some of those are going into the stores.

lines.speaker: Tillman
lines.text: I know. I’ve put those aside already.

lines.speaker: Tillman
lines.text: Keep an eye out for cherry saplings too. I’d like to grow these here.

lines.speaker: Barkley
lines.text: Oak’s useful for posts and repairs. Bring me a supply, and I’ll show you which young trees to bring back.

lines.speaker: Barkley
lines.text: Good timber. Keep any oak saplings you find while you’re cutting.

lines.speaker: Barkley
lines.text: When you lay out that orchard, remember it can grow timber as well as fruit.
lines.orchardText: The orchard can grow timber as well as fruit. Worth remembering when you’re choosing what to plant.

lines.speaker: Barkley
lines.text: Bring me birch this time. I don’t need oak for every little job.

lines.speaker: Barkley
lines.text: That’s the birch supplied. Bring back saplings when you find them—you can grow these close to town as well.

lines.speaker: Barkley
lines.text: I want some spruce put aside. Better to have it here than go looking every time someone needs a beam.

lines.speaker: Barkley
lines.text: Oak, birch and spruce. That gives us a useful timber reserve.

lines.speaker: Barkley
lines.text: When you’re ready to plant, you’ve got all three to choose from.

lines.speaker: Old Timer
lines.text: The supports need replacing. Bring me some timber before you head down there.

lines.speaker: Old Timer
lines.text: That’ll do for the supports. Mind your head down there.

minesQuest.name: Shoring Things Up
minesQuest.description: Bring 100 Logs to the Old Timer.

shortNotes: Crop quests now unlock matching seed packs.
Added a final Turnip quest and seven sapling quests.
Locked seed packs now show which quest unlocks them.
The Old Timer now needs 100 Logs to open the Mines.
Fixed Barkley’s path appearing before his house is built.
Reduced the zoom when meeting Barkley in portrait.
